pages.text: Like many flying mobs, an allay Familiar will give you a lesser version of creative flight. But its main benefit is that you can harness its natural affinity for contracts, especially simple ones for moving items.

If you press the Familiar key while looking at a block and holding a piece of paper, the paper will become a contract to take items from that block. If you press it again while holding the contract and looking at another block, it will add a clause to put items in/on the second block. If you are holding an item in your off-hand, the contract will filter for that item type.
